name: MarqueeX – Smooth Marquee Slider & News ticker
author: WPXERO

sections.description:
🚀 MarqueeX is the ultimate WordPress marquee plugin for creating smooth scrolling content, news tickers, announcement banners, and infinite content sliders. No coding required. Perfect for Gutenberg, SEO-friendly, responsive, and lightweight.

Why Choose MarqueeX

  • Create WordPress news tickers & announcement banners
  • Build scrolling text sliders & content carousels
  • Showcase testimonials, updates, or product highlights
  • SEO-optimized and fully responsive
  • Lightweight & blazing fast for best performance
  • Easy customization with visual drag & drop controls
  • Build Responsive Product Carousels & Image Galleries
  • Design Engaging Testimonial Displays with Smooth Animations
  • Add Dynamic Content Sections that Boost Engagement

Key Features

Scrolling & Marquee Controls
* Multi-directional marquee (left, right, up, down)
* Adjustable speed, timing, and acceleration
* Pause on hover & infinite scrolling loop
* Compatible with all Gutenberg blocks

Design & Layout
* Fully responsive on mobile, tablet & desktop
* Rich color, typography & layout options
* Custom CSS support
* Multiple layout styles & templates

Performance & SEO
* SEO-friendly code structure
* WCAG accessibility compliant
* Fast loading & optimized animations
* Regular updates & technical support

Perfect For Every Website Type

  • 📰 News & Magazine Sites – scrolling headlines & news tickers
  • 🛍️ eCommerce – product sliders & promotions
  • 💼 Business & Agencies – announcements, testimonials & Client Logo Displays
  • 🎉 Events – upcoming events or schedules
  • 🎨 Portfolio – work samples & image galleries

Quick Start Guide

  1. Install & Activate MarqueeX
  2. Add MarqueeX Block to Any Page/Post
  3. Customize Animation Settings
  4. Insert Your Content
  5. Preview & Publish!
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “MarqueeX”
  3. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  4. Add MarqueeX Block to Any Page/Post
  5. Customize & Add Content
sections.faq:
Is MarqueeX Really Free?

Yes! MarqueeX is completely free and open-source. No premium version, no hidden costs.

Will It Work With My Theme?

Absolutely! MarqueeX works flawlessly with any WordPress theme supporting Gutenberg.

How do I create a horizontal marquee slider?

With Marqueex, you can create smooth horizontal and vertical marquee sliders…

Can I Control Animation Settings?

Yes! Full control over scroll speed, direction, timing, and animation effects.

What Content Types Can I Display?

Any Gutenberg block content – text, images, videos, buttons, custom HTML, and more!

Is It Performance Optimized?

Yes! Built with modern optimization techniques for maximum speed and efficiency.
